The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Celeste ends it as a bonus action, or Celeste is turned or forced out by an effect like the [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]] spell. actions.desc:
Verin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]] (self only)

bonus_actions.name: Manifest Echo
bonus_actions.desc: Verin magically creates an echo—a translucent, gray object that looks like him. The echo appears in an unoccupied space Verin can see within 15 feet of himself. While the echo exists, Verin chooses whether each of his attacks originates from his space or the echo's space. On Verin's turn, the echo can move in accordance with Verin's wishes. The echo has AC 17 and 1 hit point. It otherwise uses Verin's statistics. The echo lasts for 1 minute or until it is destroyed, until Verin ends his turn more than 30 feet away from it, until Verin manifests another echo, or until Verin is incapacitated.

bonus_actions.name: Reposition
bonus_actions.desc: Verin magically swaps places with his echo.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Verin adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Xot
sb.languages: Common plus two other languages, Giant

traits.name: Siege Expert
traits.desc: Xot deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.desc: Xot counts as one size larger when determining their carrying capacity and the weight they can push, drag, or lift.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Xot makes three Thunderous Warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Thunderous Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) thunder damage.

bonus_actions.name: Telekinetic Toss (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Xot targets one Medium or smaller creature or an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried. The target, which must be within 30 feet of Xot and visible to it, is magically pushed up to 20 feet horizontally in a direction of Xot's choice. If the target is a creature, it can make a DC 13 Strength saving throw to resist the effect and is not pushed on a successful save.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The young horizonback tortoise can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
